title: Bringing a running rest back after a phone restart or an app update is never tested
what: When the phone restarts or Google Play updates MettleUp mid-rest, the phone should post the rest card again, set the end alarm for the saved time, forget a rest that already ended and bring back a recent live card. No test runs any of this. The only check reads the code text for the 'Alarms & reminders allowed' case.
expected: A test starts the phone's start-up recovery with a saved rest still running, one already ended, none at all and an old live card, and checks what is posted and when the alarm is set.
who: members who use the rest timer
how_often: every phone restart or app update during a workout
fix_line: Add a native test for the start-up recovery of a saved rest and live card

title: The 'Rest alerts' warning row is tested only as data, never on screen
what: Tests check which status each phone setting gives and the row's title for one case. Nothing checks the row on screen, which Android page each fix opens, or that the row appears and goes away without a restart. The phone flow for this row takes a picture either way and checks nothing.
expected: A phone test turns each setting off, checks the row and its words, taps it, checks the right Android page opens, fixes it and checks the row goes.
who: members whose phone holds rest alerts back
how_often: every time a phone setting blocks or delays rest alerts
fix_line: Add a phone flow that checks the row, its fix page and its refresh

title: What the workout notifications show on a locked phone is never tested
what: Six journeys promise the lock screen shows only the exercise, set and numbers, and that the note is not sent to the watch. No test checks the lock-screen setting or the content of the rest card, 'Rest is over', the live card or the note on a locked phone.
expected: A test checks each workout notification's lock-screen setting and that its text holds only the exercise, set and numbers.
who: members who train with the phone locked
fix_line: Add a check on each notification's lock-screen setting and text

title: The watch's Plus lock, the trusted-sender check and a phone without Wear OS are never tested
what: Tests only list the watch as a paid feature. Nothing checks that the watch shows 'needs MettleUp Plus' and logs no sets on the free plan, that only MettleUp's own watch app can tick sets or skip rests, or that a phone without Wear OS stays quiet without endless retries.
expected: Tests check the free-plan watch screen and refusal, a message from another app being ignored, and no retries on a phone without Wear OS.
fix_line: Add tests for the watch free-plan lock, sender check and no-Wear-OS phone

title: The 'Open MettleUp to save this set' notes are never checked for their words
what: When the phone cannot save a tapped set by itself it posts a note. Tests check that the note is posted, but not its words ('MettleUp was closed. Open it within 10 min...', 'That rest card was out of date...'), that it makes no sound or watch buzz, or that only the newest tap is kept.
expected: A test reads each note's title and text and checks it is quiet and keeps only the newest tap.
who: members who tap Done with the app closed
how_often: when the phone cannot place a tapped set
fix_line: Add checks for the note words, its quiet channel and the newest-tap rule
